## Review checklist

- [ ] Code builds and all tests pass locally
- [ ] New logic is covered by tests
- [ ] Layer dependencies respected (Domain ← Application ← Infrastructure ← Api)
- [ ] New endpoints have authorization (`[HasPermission]`) and input validation
- [ ] No secrets, passwords or connection strings committed
- [ ] Database changes include a migration and are backward compatible
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or conventions changed (`conventions.md`, `security.md`, ...)
